messages:
maria: Heads-up — infra alerted on `pool-saturation-high` again for eu-dedicated-3. It looked noisy (lots of short spikes) not sustained. Can someone point me to the exact dashboard/panel and the alert rule so we can either tune or add a short suppression window? :eyes:

liam: I saw that alert this morning. It's coming from the pool autoscale dashboard (Grafana). Panel is `Autoscale → Pool Saturation (per-pool)`. Rule name is `redwood_pool_saturation_high_v2`. We probably need to bump the `for` from 2m -> 5m.

ashwin: Quick note: those transient spikes are often from KV cache warmups on big seq requests. Might be worth adding a clause to the rule to ignore if `redwood_kvcache_miss_rate` spikes are also present.

maria: Thanks. Do we have the exact PromQL for the saturation panel? I want to link it into the incident note.

liam: PromQL from the panel (approx):

```
avg_over_time((sum by (pool) (rate(redwood_inflight_requests_total[15s])) / sum by (pool) (redwood_pool_capacity_tokens)) [1m:15s])
```

That normalizes inflight against pool token capacity so it hits ~1.0 at full saturation. Panel threshold is 0.85.

ashwin: For the KV cache metric I usually check: 
```
rate(redwood_kvcache_miss_total[1m]) / rate(redwood_kvcache_req_total[1m])
```
If that ratio jumps > 0.2 at the same time, it's probably warmups.

observability-bot: Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/pools/autoscale?orgId=1&view=pool-saturation&var-pool=eu-dedicated-3 :white_check_mark:

sara: I think a 5m `for` + ignore when `kvcache_miss_rate` > 0.15 makes sense. Also consider adding a short `until` to reopen faster once saturation is sustained (so we don't have long silences).

maria: Can one of you file a quick PR to update the alert rule and add a comment referencing this thread? If not, I can take it but won't be online in 2 hours.

liam: I'll pick this up. Planning: change `for: 2m` -> `for: 5m`, add an additional condition `and (increase(redwood_kvcache_miss_total[5m]) / increase(redwood_kvcache_req_total[5m]) < 0.15)` then add a comment and link to this thread. Will create PR and ping for review. :thumbsup:

maria: Wonderful — thanks. Please drop the PR link here when ready.

liam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-alerts/pull/482 — includes rule update + note. cc @sara @ashwin for review.

ashwin: Quick review done — LGTM except please make the ratio check use `unless` on a dev-only label to avoid blocking test pools. Minor nit added.

sara: Approved, left small wording tweak.

liam: Merged and deployed. Observability bot shows rule reload success.

observability-bot: Alerting rules reloaded (infra-alerts v1.12.3) — no errors.

maria: Thanks all. I'll keep an eye on noisy alerts next 24h and reopen if anything odd. :sparkles:

liam: FYI — I also added a dashboard annotation at the time of the change so we can correlate.

maria: Perfect.

(reacts: :thumbsup: by liam, :white_check_mark: by sara)
